quotes.quote: Windsurf - $20 gives u access to nearlly all models.
quotes.excerpt: Hey man, here's how to properly spend your 50 bucks and get the most bang for the $$: opencode go - $10 a month gets you decent allowance with latest GLM, MiniMax, and Kimi. Windsurf - $20 gives u access to nearlly all models. For me, I'm having these two subscriptions plus: shared Codex plans & shared Kimi coding Allegretto from Chinese resellers for around $10. I only use the Claude Opus/Sonnet inside Windsurf afte
quotes.story: Ask HN: $50 monthly budget, which coding models would you recommend now?
